issues.detail: The instructions lack coverage of API error handling and other edge cases beyond guardrails.
The skill is vendor-locked to the OpenAI Agents SDK and does not support other AI agent frameworks.

scenarios.name: triage-billing-order-lookup
scenarios.rationale: Response A comes closer to the rubric, defining an Agent workflow and a function tool, though it mis-specifies the return type and omits a complete run; Response B lacks the required Agent structure and correct model fields.

scenarios.name: support-guardrail
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully implements the required guardrail and exception handling, while Response B does not use the specified guardrail mechanism or exception type.

scenarios.name: streaming-handoff
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully meets the rubric with correct streaming loop, token printing, handoff detection, and final output, while Response A is missing entirely.
